raw_response:
I am already old, and this 7 mu is not much land, so I cannot take big risks. I only finished primary school, so I do not calculate like the technicians do. I look at what worked before, what the neighbors are doing, and how much cash I can safely spend. Cotton gives me cash if the price is decent, so I will still keep most land in cotton. But I also keep some wheat and maize on part of the land, because if cotton has a bad year, at least I still have grain. I have a well, so I will water when the crop really needs it, but I will not waste pumping money. Fertilizer I will use in a steady way, not too little, because if the crop turns yellow later it is hard to make up.
